■ Stage Direction
"Please be sure to remember my name too!"
—A single red line had been drawn, indicating a scratch from the race.

Umamusume running in Race 1, please line up over here!
We have a scratch, so skip number 5 and—...
H-Hey, you!
...? My name, you say?

She talks proudly about the Umamusume who will define this generation.
Then, the topic shifts to the Debut Selection Race I was unable to watch—

They might even hold an impromptu race tomorrow!
Stuff like that happens all the time! So—!

I-It's totally fine! Even if it's not the Selection Race,
you'll definitely get another chance to see them! Everyone loves to run, after all!
—Whoa.

You bet! Heheh, wanna hear some more?
Grass-chan is super good at keeping El-chan in line~...

That helps a lot, may I leave it to you? Call me if anything happens.
...Trainer, you still need to "R-E-S-T," okay?

Still, talk about rotten luck.
Getting a nosebleed right before the Selection Race, of all times.

It's listed in those handouts you have too!
In Race 1, look right there—Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!

But! This isn't the end of the line for me!
Even if the road to my debut takes longer, I won't give up!
I'll become a prospect you can't take your eyes off of, just you wait!

Spe-chan just transferred in recently too!
And this note in the corner about Sei-chan is~... spot-on!

No matter how many chances slip by.
No matter how amazing everyone else around me is.

"Any race Seiun Sky comes to watch is a must-see"—exactly right!
Sei-chan is super sharp! She's great at predicting what'll be on tests too!

And Seiun Sky, who came to observe, is also a notable contender.
Either way, I can't afford to miss anyone's run. My shoulders naturally tense with anticipation—!

I glance down at the papers in my hand.
Across that name in Race 1—

Talking with her brought excitement rather than sadness.
When I explained as much, she offered a blooming, bashful smile.

If you need help with anything, just say the word!
Don't hesitate at all!

Phew... Glad to hear that!
Ehehe... That's a relief~.

The "Debut Selection Race" is a crucial event for Trainers looking to scout.
And for the Umamusume hoping to be scouted, it's even more—
This is it?! Whaaaat~...?! Whaaaaaat......!!??

Hold on... Nurse's office! Go right now!
I'll give you a towel! Press this against it!

Touching a finger under my nose, a glistening, ink-like fluid comes away.
There's no pain, but the scent of iron and the unstoppable dripping sensation won't let up.

Um, I'll put everyone's bags together over here!
As for the Trainer's stuff... let's see.

! Right, of course! This is proof of all your hard work, Trainer.
Like a trade secret kind of thing, right?! Tsuyoshi will forget everything this instant!

...R-Really?
You're not just secretly dwelling on how sad it was to miss it...?

Today is the "Debut Selection Race"! A vital opportunity for Trainers
to gauge the Umamusume's true potential and scout them!
—! In that case...!!

Ideally, I would have liked to stay.
However, watching while bleeding from my nose would only make those around me uneasy.
Woaaah...!

Special Week just transferred in, but her late-stage kick is already famous.
And Grass Wonder, who radiated pure poise even before her debut, is also held in high regard.

Looking good, El Condor Pasa! Her left-right muscle balance is in prime shape, too.
Second-generation Umamusume King Halo is also racing. Finally, the daughter of that legend...!

Some time has passed since they finished treating me. Even as we speak,
the debut selection races must be underway. I wonder which heat is running now.

Alright, the bleeding has stopped. But make sure to rest for thirty minutes, okay?
......Oh, ah... An emergency call. ...Hrmm...

With a wry smile at her wide eyes, I took back the documents.
As a newcomer, there was still so much I fell short on compared to my seniors...

I bet Spe-chan's going to run with total freedom.
And right ahead of her, the powerful El-chan will surge forward in the lead...
Y-Your nose...! Bl—! Blood!!

......Ah. Waaaah, I'm so sorry!
It's because I brought up unnecessary stuff and made you feel disappointed again—!

Ahaha... I really wanted to run, but...
my leg started hurting. The doctor ordered me to sit out.

Umamusume racing in Race 1, please line up over here!
We have a scratch, so please skip number 5—...

I know, right?! And King-chan will attack just the same!
Making their move on the final stretch! Everyone! A sprint to the finish with their late kick!!
But you haven't just scouted King-chan and her group, you've even checked out Spe-chan's—that's seriously amazing!

Look at all these detailed notes... These are the selection race materials, right?!
So many red marks, too... You even wrote down El-chan's final furlongs!

Excuse me! I'm free right now!
Would you like me to stay and look after them?
